newsitem.title: USA: Comdial says sees no reason for stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Comdial says sees no reason for stock drop.

text.p: Comdial Corp Tuesday said it saw no reason for the recent decline in its share price and said it was "generally comfortable" with analysts' first quarter estimates.

"To our knowledge, there is no fundamental reason for the recent decline in the market price of Comdial common shares," president and chief executive officer William G. Mustain said in a statement. "We are optimistic about our company's prospects across the board, and we are generally comfortable with Wall Street projections published since February concerning the March 31 quarter, and with the consensus of all analysts who follow the company for 1997 as a whole."
First Call estimates the company will earn $0.09 a share in the first quarter of 1997.

"Our digital switching technology and our computer telephony product lines are continuing to generate very strong growth, good margins and broadening markets. We recently previewed a new generation of enhanced digital switches with broad new capabilities -- including the potential for low-cost Internet telephony access. The reactions we received were very favorable."
The stock closed yesterday at a year low of 5-5/8.
